method.name: middle-car
method.summary: Each figure is scored 0-100 against the reference cars. The middle car (median) scores 50; one 'step' is the typical spread (interquartile range / 1.349). score = 50 + 50 * tanh(direction * (value - median) / step / 3), limited to 0-100.
method.fallbackIfTooFew: use every car in the file
method.quantile: linear interpolation between sorted values: position = (n - 1) * p
method.stepFallback: if the interquartile range is 0, use the population standard deviation; if that is also 0, every car scores 50

combine.group: average of the group's metric scores that are available
combine.overall: average of group scores weighted by priority; groups with priority 0 or no score are left out; if nothing is left, no overall score
combine.headToHead: in a comparison, a metric only counts if BOTH cars have it, so a car's score alone can differ from its score in a pair

classScore.summary: Same method as the main score, but each figure is scored only against cars in the same segment (classification.segment). Used in the Garage and Rankings, never in Compare.
classScore.referenceSet: cars with status 'current' in the same segment
classScore.fallbackIfTooFew: use every car in the file in the same segment
classScore.ifStillTooFew: that figure has no class score; if no figure has one, the car has no class score and the app shows 'Not enough cars in this class yet'
classScore.noSegment: a car without a segment has no class score
classScore.everythingElse: middle, step, softness, groups, priorities and rounding are exactly as in 'method' and 'combine'

notScored.why: Battery is covered by range and efficiency. Insurance group and drag coefficient are shown and ticked in Compare but not scored yet. Length is shown only.

derived.eff: range / battery (only if both known and battery > 0)

display.round: nearest whole number for display only
display.verdict: compare rounded overall scores: equal -> 'Level', else '<car> leads by N'
